title: Separate information per move from wall-time latency exposure
statement: If all transitions/emissions scale linearly with positive predictable current and dark evolution is absent,the dose-domain law is invariant under current time change. Lower current reduces fixed-wall-time blind exposure but increases elapsed time;new probe laws,nonlinear excitation and dark dynamics break that conclusion.

requires: Known closed three-state generator and static rigid-template marked Poisson emissions
Actual sub-dwell timestamps and no-click intervals through the final beam-off cut
Paid event-to-blanker timing and initial-state assumptions
provides: A source-bound resource conversion with its actual assumptions
assumptions: Not a universal microscope latency law
costs: Source reports8000initial+6000buffered simulated runs;all incident exposure,latency and rejected trials count
Lower current trades wall time for blind-delay dose only under the stated time-change law
contract.units: Electron incident dose e/angstrom^2 and mean-electron counts;source angle/length/energy conventions remain explicit. Fluence is not a transition probability.
contract.obstruction: A wall-time controller change need not improve information per induced move.

body: Transition/reverse rates,closed-state coverage,emissions,initial distribution and timing are supplied,not acquired. Simulated accurate endpoint reports are not high desired-defect yield or preselected preparation. Ordinary dynamic filtering receives identical information. Zero reports in the high-transition case is failure to deliver a useful endpoint,not zero-error success. Actual CrSBr tracking,blanker path,damage coverage and full-cycle advantage remain open. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Delivered conditional source derivation/numerical diagnostic at its stated scope. No new scientific review is requested or performed;physical acquisition and advantage remain unacquired. Prior parent acceptance is not silently widened to this distinct continuation.
